claim: MAJOR CORRECTION to E033: the splitter-validation-failed-twice on nomad2018 is TASK-LEVEL, not haiku-specific. E-PN9 ran with SONNET splitter (from the family-promoted entry) and ALSO hit splitter verification failure twice → pipeline halt at $0.49. The nomad2018 task itself has an unstable splitter requirement that hits some non-trivial failure rate regardless of model. Mitigation candidates: (1) raise the splitter retry count from 2 to 3-4 in pipeline_reliability config for tabular tasks; (2) keep splitter on the strongest model (opus) on nomad2018; (3) accept the variance as unfixable at the model layer. CompositeRouter behaved correctly — it hit the family entry, returned the mixed routing without firing the LLM bridge. The Static routing + Composite path is validated; the failure is upstream of routing.

support.composite_router_decision: Static layer hit family entry without firing LLM: {splitter: sonnet, designer: sonnet, coder: sonnet, rest: haiku}

failure.cause: RuntimeError: splitter agent failed verification twice

support.diagnosis: Splitter verification failure occurs at non-trivial rate INDEPENDENT of splitter model. Likely a task-level stability issue (the verifier requires specific split-format properties nomad2018's data doesn't trivially satisfy, OR the validator itself is flaky).

scope: n=2 splitter failure (E033 haiku + E036 sonnet) of n=4 nomad runs that reached splitter — 50% failure rate. Real signal that splitter on nomad2018 is unstable.
limitations: Could not inspect WHY the splitter verifier rejected — would need to read the verifier's complaint text in the splitter run output.
n=4 total, n=2 failures — failure rate confidence is medium.
confidence: high (re E033 correction: splitter failure is not haiku-specific) / medium (re the failure rate)

implications.corrections_to_E033: E033 attributed splitter failure to haiku variance. E036 shows it happens with sonnet too — the failure is task-level. E033's haiku splitter rate is therefore not a model-tier indictment.
implications.family_memory_update: Should we change the promoted splitter to opus for nomad2018? Untested. Until then, the failure rate is the operational cost of the cost-saving routing.
implications.next_experiment: Skip nomad2018 for the rest of this loop window — the splitter instability is now well-documented. Pivot to leaf-classification with composite router: family default for image-classification is opus-all (from family memory). Compare to E022 X215 routing $12. CompositeRouter should pick opus-all baseline; alternative could be opus-coder+aggregator only routing.

next_actions: Document nomad2018 splitter instability in task_memory/tabular-regression.json open_questions.
Next experiment: E-PN10-leaf-composite OR audit other task_memory entries for similar drifts that the loop could detect.
